title: Add opt-in console sounds
problem: Console input is silent and has no user-controlled audio preference.
action_items: Read AGENTS.md, README and relevant installed Next docs before changes. Preserve concurrent pm-240/pm-241 work, use additive interfaces, and apply the shared delivery and browser-evidence rules in plan.md. Commit and push the finished slice with pm-242/<task_id>: and the owner identity; stop implementation work at the push.
Create a pure tested cue/envelope table and a site-local lazy WebAudio adapter; square waves, short attack/decay, capped gain at -18 dB. Export move/open/back/chime/eat/burst cues for later tasks.
Add a fixed-size accessible speaker toggle beside the theme toggle; off by default, aria-pressed and storage key sound. Use a hydration-safe external store and handle denied storage.
Create/resume AudioContext only in a user gesture, reuse it, handle rejected resume safely and close on pagehide. Wire menu movement and A activation; do not add audio to other figures.

Add scripts/probe-sound.sh and .mjs using the existing temporary pinned Playwright pattern. Prove no constructor before gesture/off, one context after enable, persistence, toggle-off silence, blocked storage/autoplay fallback and no masthead shift. Inspect both themes at desktop and mobile.
acceptance_criteria: Sound starts muted; enable, move and open produce short cues only after a gesture. Mute and blocked autoplay remain usable, preference survives reload when storage works, and the masthead stays stable.

title: Tilt the pocket console
problem: The console has no subtle pointer depth response.
action_items: Read AGENTS.md, README and relevant installed Next docs before changes. Preserve concurrent pm-240/pm-241 work, use additive interfaces, and apply the shared delivery and browser-evidence rules in plan.md. Commit and push the finished slice with pm-242/<task_id>: and the owner identity; stop implementation work at the push.

Add an optional tilt prop to Machine and opt Handheld in; preserve all callers. Map pointer position to bounded +/-6 degree CSS perspective rotation and opposite shadow shift; restore the base transform on leave.

Enable only on hover-capable pointers with no reduced-motion preference, react to preference changes and reset on hidden/unmount. Keep pointer work event-driven and animate the outer compositor transform, outside the filtered ink.

Add scripts/probe-tilt.sh/.mjs: pointer changes transform, leave resets within 500 ms; touch and reduced motion stay still, including mid-hover preference change; controls, boot and focus still work. Inspect desktop/mobile and both themes.
non_goals: Drag rotation or new back faces
acceptance_criteria: A hover pointer tilts only the console within six degrees; leave returns to the original pose, and touch/reduced-motion users see the still console with working controls.

Add per-figure Hand picker and Re-roll control through Machine's existing knobs. Add explicit off-by-default Boil at six seed changes per second through the existing tick machinery; only one figure boils at a time and stop when hidden/offscreen.

Test leg ordering, conservation of emitted/queued/in-flight/stored/shown counts, paused queue accumulation, resume drain, eight-packet backfill, id uniqueness, immutable input and finite settle. Use explicit frames/fixtures; no wall clock, random source or live service.

title: Add the cached Now Playing cassette
problem: Music has no readable cassette/game label or safe provider integration.
action_items: Read AGENTS.md, README and relevant installed Next docs before changes. Preserve concurrent pm-240/pm-241 work, use additive interfaces, and apply the shared delivery and browser-evidence rules in plan.md. Commit and push the finished slice with pm-242/<task_id>: and the owner identity; stop implementation work at the push.

Create pure unknown-input parsers/types for Spotify current track and Steam current game; strip unneeded fields, validate external URLs, cap display lengths and return null for malformed, private, empty and error fixtures.

Add a server-rendered cassette and game cartridge below the music television using site.now and the existing playlist as the quiet face. Include ordinary text/links, provider credits, reserved label space and an explicit quiet state. Build the quiet rendering first, then add the server adapter in a separate focused commit.

Keep current TV, owner channel controls and authorization unchanged. Add scripts/walk-now-playing.sh in QUIET_ONLY=1 mode for local production HTML and scripts/probe-cassette.sh/.mjs for long fixture text, no-JS, contrast, responsive fit and reduced-motion still reels.

Read installed caching, cacheLife, route-handler and request-time docs plus README Live data. Add one server-only adapter holding all provider fetches/env access. Inject host overrides only through validated server env; never accept a user-supplied upstream URL.

Implement Spotify refresh/current-track and optional public Steam current-game adapters with four-second aborts, independent provider failures, pure parsing, no retries and no network at build. Never log or serialize credentials. Missing configuration yields quiet/static labels without network.

Make /music request-time with the documented boundary before awaiting the cached reader, retaining existing television and owner tools. Use use cache/cacheLife with roughly 60 s revalidation and expire >=300; stamp read time visibly. Prove a no-JS live-fixture response instead of leaving it in Suspense fallback.

Add GET /api/now-playing as an on-demand read of the identical cached reader used by /music; return only sanitized display data and state with 200 for quiet/failure. No cron, separate collector or unprotected cache-purge endpoint.

Extend walk-now-playing.sh with temporary loopback token/Spotify/Steam providers and ephemeral env values: first call, cache reuse, forced fixture-clock/invalidation through a checkout-only test seam, 204/401/429/malformed/private data, dead/slow upstream, independent partial failure and no requests during build. Production paths must not expose fixture or bypass controls.

Document env names/placeholders, setup scopes, optional current-game privacy and the activation handoff. This build uses fixtures and requires no person prerequisite. The first later run actually needing account setup raises operator_action at its start using spotify-app:now-playing or steam-key:current-game and ends that run; live output remains unproven until independently observed.

Extend cassette probe to live fixtures, long labels, reduced-motion reels, no-JS content and a secret-sentinel scan of HTTP responses/client chunks. Preserve all current auth and channel e2e behavior.
non_goals: Production OAuth consent or secret installation
acceptance_criteria: Music gains one readable paper cassette/game label with the quiet fallback and unchanged television/owner controls. The exact cached reader serves /music and GET /api/now-playing; local fake-provider success, partial failure, absent credentials and outage cases produce bounded safe output, no-JS receives the fixture reading, and builds/client output contain no network calls or secrets. Real provider activation is explicitly outside this task's proven integration scope.

Read installed Next layout/script guidance. Keep the intro inside the console: brief stepped flicker, scan, OTOHIME print and small cartridge click-in; encode the finite sequence as tested data with total duration at most 2.4 s and each movement at most 400 ms.

Use guarded sessionStorage console:booted and a pre-paint html attribute to skip animation delays as well as durations on returning visits. Mark completion from the finite sequence and handle interrupted boot/denied storage without hiding the menu.

Integrate the shared chime only if sound is on and this document already has an unlocked gesture context; cold loads remain silent. Reduced motion shows the final usable menu immediately; essential menu links remain in initial HTML.

Add scripts/probe-boot.sh/.mjs for fresh session, same-session route return/reload, new session, interrupted intro, blocked storage, no-JS, reduced motion and audio eligibility. Compare reserved layout bounds across the sequence in both themes and sizes.
acceptance_criteria: First session visit shows a finite in-console boot, subsequent visits skip all intro delays, and blocked storage/no-JS/reduced motion preserve a usable menu. Chime obeys explicit audio opt-in and browser gesture policy.

Under reduced motion disable the automatic tick and advance one cell per direction; pause on hidden/offscreen, stop on loss/menu/unmount, bound SVG work by board size and announce score/state without flooding live regions.

Add scripts/probe-pocket-game.sh/.mjs for real B/A/arrows, deterministic food/scoring through a checkout-only fixture, collision/restart/menu, high-score restore, corrupt/blocked storage, correct/wrong scoped code, footer isolation and reduced-motion explicit-step-only play.
acceptance_criteria: Deterministic reducer traces prove movement, seeded food, scoring, loss, restart and debug wrapping. B opens pipeline snake inside the LCD; A/restart/d-pad, scoring, collisions and persisted best score work. Scoped Konami unlocks wrapping independently of the footer; reduced motion is turn-based and menu navigation survives.
